Clean. Summary of what changed:

- [button.css](formats/components/src/components/button/button.css) now wraps its whole selector set in `@scope (.pfx-button) { & { … } &.-color-primary { … } … }`, matching the pattern used by [alert.css](formats/components/src/components/alert/alert.css) and other `.css`-authored records.
- [index.ts](formats/components/src/components/button/index.ts)'s interpolated block (mask + ghost-wash rules) is unaffected — it stays flat/literal since it's appended after the scope closes.
- Fixed a latent bug in [aliases.ts](formats/components/src/lib/aliases.ts): `withSizeAliases`/`withAliases` were appending generated twin rules (with bare `&` selectors) *after* a trailing `@scope` block's closing brace, which is invalid CSS and silently dropped by parsers — this had already broken the `-size-small`/`-size-large` twins for `radio`/`range-input`. Added `appendGenerated()` so these twins are inserted *inside* the `@scope` block when the body ends in one.
- Updated [button.test.ts](formats/components/tests/components/button.test.ts) and [sheets.test.ts](formats/components/tests/sheets.test.ts) assertions to match the new `&.-modifier` scoped selectors.
